LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker.label: personal locker
LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker.description: A tall steel locker for storing personal effects. Standard issue in facility changing rooms and dormitories.
LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker_Large.label: locker bank
LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker_Large.description: A bank of three steel lockers bolted together. Standard issue in facility changing rooms and dormitories.
LanguageData.DMS_Waterdispenser.label: water dispenser
LanguageData.DMS_Waterdispenser.description: A bottled water dispenser with hot and cold taps. A small comfort in an otherwise sterile facility.
LanguageData.DMS_Benches.label: waiting bench
LanguageData.DMS_Benches.description: A row of three padded seats on a steel frame, of the kind found in facility corridors and waiting areas. Somewhat comfortable to sit on.
LanguageData.DMS_Airpurifier.label: air purifier
LanguageData.DMS_Airpurifier.description: A free-standing air purification unit. Its filters strip dust and contaminants out of the air, keeping the facility's rooms clean.
LanguageData.DMS_Hydroponics_Flowerpot.label: hydroponic planter
LanguageData.DMS_Hydroponics_Flowerpot.description: A self-contained hydroponic planter with its own nutrient reservoir. Grow decorative flowers here to improve the mood of people nearby.
LanguageData.DMS_PersonallockerDestroyed.label: ruined personal locker
LanguageData.DMS_PersonallockerDestroyed.description: A rusted-out steel locker. Its door has been forced and whatever was inside is long gone. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker_LargeDestroyed.label: ruined locker bank
LanguageData.DMS_Personallocker_LargeDestroyed.descri: A bank of three rusted-out steel lockers. The doors hang open or are missing entirely, and whatever was inside is long gone. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_WaterdispenserDestroyed.label: ruined water dispenser
LanguageData.DMS_WaterdispenserDestroyed.description: The wreck of a water dispenser. The bottle is cracked and empty, and the taps have corroded solid. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_BenchesDestroyed.label: ruined waiting bench
LanguageData.DMS_BenchesDestroyed.description: A row of seats on a rusted steel frame. The padding has rotted away and the frame is bent, so nobody will be sitting here again. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_AirpurifierDestroyed.label: ruined air purifier
LanguageData.DMS_AirpurifierDestroyed.description: The wreck of an air purification unit. Its filters are clogged solid and the housing has rusted through. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Hydroponics_FlowerpotDestroyed.label: ruined hydroponic planter
LanguageData.DMS_Hydroponics_FlowerpotDestroyed.descr: A dead hydroponic planter. The nutrient reservoir dried out long ago, leaving only a crust of withered roots. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
